back_translation: Do not rejoice, O Israel; do not exult like the nations, for you have played the harlot, forsaking your God; you have loved a prostitute's wages on every threshing floor.
The threshing floor and winepress will not feed them, and the new wine will fail them.
They will not remain in the land of the LORD; Ephraim will return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria.

They will not pour out wine offerings to the LORD, and their sacrifices will not be pleasing to Him, but will be to them like the bread of mourners; everyone who eats it will be defiled. For their bread will be for themselves to satisfy hunger; it will not enter the house of the LORD.
What will you do on the appointed feast day, on the day of the feast of the LORD?
For behold, even if they flee from destruction, Egypt will gather them and Memphis will bury them. Thistles will take over their precious silver, and thorns will overrun their tents.

The days of punishment have come; the days of retribution have come—let Israel know it. The prophet is called a fool, and the man of the spirit is called insane, because of your great iniquity and great hostility.
The prophet is Ephraim's watchman along with my God, yet the fowler's snare lies on all his paths, and hostility is in the house of his God.
They have corrupted themselves deeply as in the days of Gibeah; He will remember their guilt and punish their sins.

I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers like the firstfruits of the fig tree in its first season. But they went to Baal-peor and consecrated themselves to Shame, and became as detestable as the thing they loved.
Ephraim's glory will fly away like a bird—no birth, no pregnancy, no conception.
Even if they raise their children, I will bereave them of every one. Woe to them when I turn away from them!
I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a meadow; but Ephraim will bring out his children to be slaughtered.
O LORD, give them—what will You give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
All their evil appears at Gilgal, for there I hated them. Because of the wickedness of their deeds, I will drive them out of My house; I will love them no more; all their leaders are rebellious.
Ephraim is struck down; their root is withered; they will bear no fruit. Even if they have children, I will slay the beloved ones of their womb.
My God will reject them because they did not obey Him, and they will become wanderers among the nations.
